mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_user (id, username, password_hash, display_name, status, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{status}, #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash, display_name, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM iam_user WHERE username = #{username}
